# How to prepare a visit bag

Steps for volunteers packing a bag for a [[Hearthside Visits|homebound service]] visit.

## Choosing titles

Start from the patron's card: authors they liked, ones they did not, and preferred print size. Pick six to ten items, mixing one or two new authors with familiar ones. Check the reading history printout so you do not repeat a title. Large print comes from the [[Large print collection]].

## Audiobook players

Patrons who struggle with discs get a preloaded player. Charge it, load two books, and tape a card with large-type instructions to the back.

## Checking out

Check items out to the patron, not to yourself, with the six-week loan. Put the receipt in the bag.
